description: A small 'cottage style' Roman villa situated centrally within the Bronze Age hillfort. Built late 1st - early 2nd CE, and ultimately abandoned at the end of the 3rd CE. Ceramic tiles sent into the corner wall of one room were suggested to have been a small household shrine.
bibliography: Gosden, and Lock. “Becoming Roman on the Berkshire Downs: The Evidence from Alfreds Castle.” Britannia 34 (2003).
